# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# command.py:6676-6681 supports snapshot/follow; 555-562 preserves full snapshot
# output. Go defaults to snapshot and retains a bounded byte prefix.
taskfile success.json success
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id log-success --wait
job-id JOB
skygo jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^hello from the workload\n$'
! stderr .
skygo jobs logs $JOB --offset 6
stdout '^from the workload\n$'
skygo jobs logs $JOB --offset 24
! stdout .
skygo jobs logs $JOB --follow
stdout '^hello from the workload\n$'
! stderr .

# JSON log chunks are protobuf JSON: bytes are base64, int64 offsets strings.
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB
stdout '"data": *"aGVsbG8gZnJvbSB0aGUgd29ya2xvYWQK"'
stdout '"next_offset": *"24"'
stdout '"complete": *true'
! stdout 'hello from'
! stderr .
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --offset -1
stderr 'offset must not be negative'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --offset 999
stderr 'invalid_argument:.*offset exceeds retained output'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs logs 00000000000000000000000000000000
stderr 'not_found'
! stdout .
